review_notes: I read the whole file. Its only definitions are problem-specific real-valued constants: uniCb, uniFlowGrad, uniFlowAvg, uniFlowAvgA0Plus, uniSeedA0Plus and uniCoeff. Each is a closed-form expression in the project's own quantities, such as Nstar, amnrFlowGradientSpatialConstant, amnrMemoryConstant and amnrKmatStepConstant. Everything else in the file is a theorem. I found no Mathlib, Batteries or core concept that these constants or the AMNR word, weight and budget machinery duplicate. The `uni*` constants are deliberately uniform-in-I versions of upstream constants, as the module docstring explains. I did not run a broad search of the Mathlib sources, so a duplicate I did not think of remains possible but unlikely.
